unit_system: natural-HEP with c = 1 and e = 1: energies and momenta in GeV, rigidity in GV, modulation potential phi in GV (|Z| phi in GeV); fluxes per unit of the energy variable of the chosen kind, arbitrary normalization in the benchmark
scales: not-applicable (no renormalization or factorization scale); one modulation potential phi per period
energy_variable: one of: total kinetic energy T of the nucleus (GeV, shift |Z| phi); kinetic energy per nucleon T/A (GeV/n, shift (|Z|/A) phi) [helmod:C04]; rigidity R = p/|Z| (GV); the LIS power law and the flux are per unit of the same variable
frame: heliocentric; LIS at the modulation boundary, TOA at 1 AU
mass_approximation: rest mass of the whole nucleus given by the caller (no particle constants shipped); per-nucleon mass m/A
helmod:modulation_model: force field (Gleeson-Axford): zero streaming, spherical symmetry, steady state, diffusion coefficient proportional to rigidity; J_TOA(T) = p(T)^2 / p(T + |Z| phi)^2 J_LIS(T + |Z| phi) [helmod:C01]
helmod:observable: differential flux at 1 AU (top of the atmosphere) predicted from a LIS; no charge-sign, drift, latitude or transient effects
